title: Soil Moisture Pilot Study
key_sentences: Farmers in the valley have reported uneven crop growth on terraced fields.
The pilot study tests whether low-cost sensors can explain these differences.
The team placed sensors at three depths on twelve terraces.
Readings were taken every hour from May to August.
Each sensor stores its readings on a memory card that is collected weekly.
Missing values are flagged rather than filled in.
The results will be shared with the farmers at a meeting in the autumn.

list_items.text: Record the time of arrival and the weather conditions.
Check that every sensor is still upright and undamaged.
Replace the memory card and label the old card with the terrace number.
Clean the solar panel with a dry cloth.
Note any changes to the terrace, such as new planting or erosion.
